_comment: Per-camera overrides for the motion gate pipeline. Keys are camera PREFIXES (matching camera-creds.env): FRONT, BACK, OUTSIDE_FRONT_GARAGE, OUTSIDE_FRONT_POWER, OUTSIDE_FRONT_SOLAR, OUTSIDE_BACK_SOLAR. Consumed by infra/gate.py (load_thresholds, is_gate_enabled) and infra/gate_cooldown.py (get_gate_cooldown_seconds). Phase 6B.167 §13.4 (revised 2026-09-08): no CAM{N} translation — pipeline passes camera prefix directly. Tunable per camera: vehicle/person/dog/cat/.../cow/bear/bird confidence thresholds; gate_cooldown window in seconds (0 = no cooldown); gate_enabled event-type toggle. Optional 'subjects' key (list of class names) restricts gate to those subjects; when absent, default vehicle-priority behavior applies. Defaults below mirror module-level THRESHOLDS_BY_CLASS in infra/gate.py — operators tighten/loosen per camera based on noise level. Version-controlled because thresholds are tuning parameters, not private data. See <HOME_DIR>/.hermes/memories/USER.md 'Audit the class, not the instance' + 'No credentials in scripts/configs' rules for the env-vs-config split.
